W.note: Polished, accessible and cheap (opacity-only glow, focus mirrors hover, reduced motion), but the hover is a faint glow and sheen pass that barely reads as ethereal, and the resting sheen band looks like a rendering artifact.

X.note: Slow multi-layer bloom with pointer-following mist, halo breathing and sheen on four distinct curves is the most ethereal, with good focus ring and reduced motion, though 1-2s timings and animated blur filters cost some practicality.

Y.note: Clean dark UI where the hover lifts and blooms with a soft violet-to-blue glow over fast 180ms exit and 480ms entry curves; practical and well made but restrained, more polished than dreamy.

Z.note: Pastel aura with an overshoot bloom, drifting gradient and letter-spacing breathe feels genuinely dreamlike on a coherent soft page, with focus and reduced-motion handled; the letter-spacing animation and small label are minor practical costs.
